notes.title: ♟️ New Update & 5 Years of BOT.vinnik! ♟️
notes.content: [p]Hello, fellow chess enthusiasts![/p][p][/p][p]Last week marked [b]5 years[/b] since the launch of the first game in our BOT.vinnik franchise! To celebrate this special milestone and reinforce our commitment to the series, we've released a new update for [b]BOT.vinnik Chess: Combination Lessons[/b], featuring several enhancements inspired by our latest project, [b]BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy[/b] (available now for wishlist!)[/p][p][/p][h3]Check out what's new:[/h3][list][*][p]🔊 [b]New BOT.vinnik Reactions:[/b] We imported all the updated quotes and reactions directly from our newest game, making our beloved robot instructor even more expressive and sarcastic than ever.[/p][/*][*][p]✏️ [b]Comprehensive Text Revision:[/b] Conducted a thorough review of all content, eliminating typos, improving syntax, and making texts clearer and more enjoyable.[/p][/*][*][p]🖥️ [b]Windowed Mode:[/b] You can now easily switch between fullscreen and windowed mode by pressing [b]ALT + ENTER[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Addressed issues related to incorrectly swapped achievements.[/p][/*][*][p]📈 [b]Gameplay Flow Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Clarified when clicks are necessary to proceed.[/p][/*][*][p]Immediate feedback for correct moves, removing the need to wait for previous incorrect comments.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🎨 [b]Minor Visual Refinements:[/b] Subtle adjustments behind the chessboard for an improved visual experience.[/p][/*][*][p]🚀 [b]New Splash Screen:[/b] Featuring our updated studio brand, Deep Green Games![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]New Game: BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy![/h2][p]Excited about these updates? There's something even bigger on the horizon! The demo for our latest project, [b]BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy[/b], is almost ready, and you can already add it to your wishlist on Steam:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Your support means the world to us![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for the incredible 5 years, here's to many more.[/p][p]— Deep Green Games Team.[/p]

notes.title: ♟️ -50% OFF! Celebrating 5 Years of BOT.vinnik ♟️
notes.content:
[h3]Hey there, chess lovers!
[/h3][p]This week marks the [b]5th anniversary[/b] of the very first game in the BOT.vinnik series — and we’re celebrating with a [b]50% discount[/b] on [b]BOT.vinnik Chess: Combination Lessons[/b] during the Steam Summer Sale![/p][p]But that’s not all: we’ve also pushed a small update with quality-of-life improvements, visual tweaks, and updated reaction quotes from our newest game — which you can [b]wishlist right now[/b]:


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If you enjoy BOT.vinnik’s grumpy coaching style, you’ll love what we’re building next.[/p][p]

notes.title: The BOT.VINNIK you’ve been waiting for is finally here!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, comrades!
[/h3]
You may have noticed we’ve been radio silent for a while—but there’s a good reason: we’ve spent the last few years working on the most ambitious BOT.VINNIK project to date!

🎉 BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy is now live on Steam:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy/[/url]

This new game is the culmination of everything we’ve learned from the previous titles in the series. Alongside a brand-new visual style, it features:
[list]

[*] A reworked scoring system

[*] Structured progression across lessons

[*] Multiple difficulty levels

[*] A growing platform powered by future DLCs

[*] And even a beginner mode for those who don’t know how the knight moves yet

[/list]
Of course, BOT.VINNIK’s trademark sarcasm and brutal honesty are back and sharper than ever.

A free demo will be released soon — until then, check out the trailer and hit that Wishlist button to let BOT.VINNIK know you’re still worthy of being called "comrade."
(YouTube™ embed: “BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy – Reveal Trailer”)

Thanks for all the support over the years!
See you at the Academy.


Rodrigo & Eduardo
Deep Green Games

notes.title: BIG UPDATE!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

It's been a month since launch, and we are thrilled with the reception the game has had so far! Even our charming instructor is grateful!
As a way to thank all of you for the incredible support, we are releasing a major game update, containing:

- Achievements (everyone likes achievements, right? Or so we've heard)!
- 50% more content and TWO more chapters with brand new tactical themes.
- support for macOS! (included in the last few weeks)

We hope you like it and keep studying chess while having fun!

One last thing:
There's more BOT.vinnik on the way! Stay tuned!
